title: Q-AUDIT-d1-growth: fm-d1-growth failing (fail): Add or tighten its retention rows in seed/autonomy/retention.json and archive old rows through the audit chain
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** the daily failure audit files it; the executor takes it in driver order
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation failure_audit --probe d1-growth
**Status:** open

Failure mode `fm-d1-growth` detected by `d1-growth`, failing since 2026-11-26T16:03:00Z.
Evidence: latest cost reading measured no D1 database (rows read and size unknown)
cost level 0.805 of budget is at or above warn_level 0.8

Signature: 72cf40d9a32e (disposition: fix).
Suspected root cause: a database's measured growth reaches the size limit inside the horizon
Remedy: Add or tighten its retention rows in seed/autonomy/retention.json and archive old rows through the audit chain
Fix the earliest cause, so the detector passes; do not weaken or remove the detector.

**Closing probe:** cmd:python3 -m foundation failure_audit --probe d1-growth
